messages:
incident-bot: ALERT fired: latency SLO burn in eu-central. p99 1500ms (>700ms), p95 380ms (>250ms). link: https://monitoring.redwood.example/alerts/1759000000

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page fired -> rotation: oncall@redwood -> severity P1

Noah (oncall): acked. I'm on it. Rachel please watch autoscaler, Max check recent canaries. Olivia hold on routing.

Rachel (sre): autoscaler thrashing: pods 2->20->6 over 8m. queue depth x9. cpu per sidecar >85%.

Max (eng-runtime): canary v3-batch rolled ~12m ago to 25% traffic. batching heuristic changed (max_batch_time=30ms) and new batch key hashing.

Olivia (prodops): support reports interactive lag from EU customers, no 5xxs. Current route spread eu-central/eu-west.

Noah (oncall): quick mitigations: 1) token throttle on long-seq routes 2) reduce batch window 3) cap canary 0% 4) warm-cache hot prefixes

Olivia (prodops): applying token throttle on /chat/stream: 
```
routerctl throttle --route /chat/stream --concurrency 100 --burst 150 --reason "p99 SLO burn"
```

Max (eng-runtime): can apply legacy-key-hash flag dynamically to stop cache churn. toggling now via runtime admin.

Max (eng-runtime): flag toggled -> legacy_key_hash=true. observing metrics.

Rachel (sre): after throttle + flag change, p99 down 1500 -> 920ms in 3m, p95 down to 260ms. queue depth halving.

Noah (oncall): cap canary v3-batch to 0% traffic now.

Max (eng-runtime): rolled v3-batch -> 0% with rollout-controller; convergence ~40s.

Rachel (sre): warm-cache job started for top 150 prefixes in eu-central:
```
jobsctl start warm-prefixes --region eu-central --count 150
```

SupportOps: notified affected customers: BrightHealth, NovaApps. Drafted advisory and pending final wording.

Olivia (prodops): autoscaler cooldown increased to 180s and target_cpu bumped to 85 to reduce churn.

Rachel (sre): p99 stable ~470ms after 10m. no new PD pages.

Noah (oncall): assigning follow-ups: Max -> RCA + PR for batch-key test; Rachel -> runbook update for autoscaler settings; Olivia -> routing policy for long-seq fallbacks; SupportOps -> customer comms and post-incident summary.

Max (eng-runtime): created incident PM INC-1759000000 with traces: https://pm.redwood.example/INC-1759000000

incident-bot: status -> mitigated. will auto-resolve in 45m if no regression.

pagerduty-bot: incident acknowledged by Noah (oncall). escalation suppressed.

Noah (oncall): leaving thread open for postmortem link. Closing active pager. final check in 30m.
